_comment: Prescribed vertical extents for extracted (non-symbol) PLT fonts. Each prescription maps its characters' ink bounding box, at extraction time, onto [-descent_percent%, 1000 + ascent_percent%] in the library design frame (line height = capline - baseline = 1000 units). X is never touched; AA arcs are refit natively (fonts/glyph_transforms.py). The reference character is always exempt. Load: fonts/extract_plt_fonts.py --prescriptions-file.
